qs.q: Phenylketonuria (PKU) is caused by deficiency of phenylalanine hydroxylase. Untreated it causes
o: Severe intellectual disability, seizures, musty odor, fair skin and hair, eczema
qs.e: Phenylalanine accumulates → phenylketones in urine (musty/mousy odor). Blocks tyrosine synthesis → decreased melanin (fair skin/hair/eyes). Autosomal recessive. Diagnosed on newborn screening (Guthrie test/tandem mass spectrometry). Treatment: phenylalanine-restricted diet + sapropterin in BH4-responsive cases. Start treatment immediately to prevent intellectual disability.
